product.title: Rochiile prințesei. Albă-ca-Zăpada. Îmbracă păpușa!
product.description: Vino în lumea poveștilor cu prințese! Ajut-o pe Albă-ca-Zăpada să se îmbrace pentru o plimbare în pădure sau pentru o seară de bal. Potrivindu-i hainele și accesoriile, poți obține nenumărate ținute speciale! Fermecătoarea prințesă va arăta superb îmbrăcată cu rochiile, fustele, bluzele pe care i le vei alege, încălțată cu pantofiorii ei minunați și purtând toate accesoriile pe care le cere eticheta de prințesă.

# Snow White Princess Dresses for Doll Play | Litera Brand Toys

Bring the magic of fairy tales to life with this enchanting collection from **Litera**. This set allows children to immerse themselves in the world of princesses, focusing on the beloved character, Snow White. Whether staging a grand ball or having a quiet stroll through the forest, your little one can dress up and role-play unforgettable princess moments.

The goal of this wonderful doll accessory set is to let children craft countless special outfits for their dolls. By combining the included dresses, skirts, blouses, beautiful footwear, and decorative accessories, imaginative play never ends! Watch as the gorgeous princess looks spectacular dressed in every combination.

## ð Endless Creative Play with Doll Accessories

This royal wardrobe set provides comprehensive elements to enhance doll storytelling. It moves beyond just a dress, giving children creative control over styling and character development. The ability to mix and match pieces ensures that every play session feels like a brand new adventure.

**What's Included in the Set?**
*   Beautiful Princess Dresses (Themed around Snow White)

This is the perfect gift for children who love imaginative play, fashion, and classic fairy tales like those featuring Snow White.
